hook: NASA crushed its own Moon rocket tank on purpose.
narration: NASA squeezed its own Moon rocket tank with millions of pounds of force.
It was built just like the oxygen tanks on the Moon rocket.
Hydraulic cylinders pressed in from every side while engineers measured the strain.
[short pause] Then the wall gave way.
Water stood in for the liquid oxygen, which is far too cold and dangerous to spill.
The point was proof that the real tanks can survive the forces of launch.
outcome: The tank finally broke, and water gushed out across the test stand.
title: Moon rocket tank crushed until it burst
description:
At NASA's Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, engineers pushed a test copy of the Space Launch System liquid oxygen tank beyond its limits in June 2020 until it broke and water gushed out.

Footage: NASA Marshall Space Flight Center video, via NASA Image and Video Library: https://images.nasa.gov/details/MSFC_2020_XP_SLS_V_0130_PD002-Test-Case-TTF-4697%20LOX%20Tank%20Test-to-Failure%20color-1_06242020_timelapse
